# City of Madison, Wisconsin

> Official municipal website for Madison, Wisconsin providing access to city government services, departments, permits, and civic information.

The City of Madison website serves as the central hub for Wisconsin's capital city, offering residents and businesses access to municipal departments, public services, permits, and governance information. The site connects users to key city agencies including Common Council, Finance, Engineering, Fire, Police, Parks, and various administrative offices.

## Key Topics

- Common Council
- City of Madison
- Municipal Departments
- Permits and Inspections
- City Services
- Public Records
- Civic Engagement
- Madison Parks
- Finance and Budget
- Building Codes
- Housing Authority
- Police Accountability
- Economic Development
- Civil Rights
- Public Health

## Core Government & Administration

- [City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com): Main homepage for City of Madison with news, services, and civic information
- [Departments | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/departments): Directory of municipal departments and administrative offices
- [Common Council | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/council): Common Council meetings, agendas, and council member information
- [Finance | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/finance): Finance Department managing city budget, taxes, and financial statements
- [Clerk's Office | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/clerk): Clerk's Office for elections, voting, and voter registration services
- [Attorney - City of Madison, Wisconsin](https://www.cityofmadison.com/attorney): City Attorney's Office providing legal services and ordinance enforcement

## Public Safety & Accountability

- [Fire | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/fire): Fire Department providing emergency services, safety, and recruitment
- [Independent Police Monitor | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/independent-police-monitor): Independent Police Monitor for civilian complaints and police accountability
- [Civil Rights | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/civil-rights): Civil Rights Department handling discrimination complaints and equity

## Development, Permits & Infrastructure

- [Building Inspection | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/dpced/building-inspection): Building permits, inspection scheduling, and code enforcement services
- [Engineering | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/engineering): Engineering Department overseeing infrastructure, permits, and public works
- [Economic Development - DPCED - City of Madison, Wisconsin](https://www.cityofmadison.com/dpced/economicdevelopment): Economic Development Division supporting business resources and real estate
- [Community Development | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/dpced/community-development): Community Development Division with housing and social services programs

## Housing & Property Services

- [Housing Authority - DPCED - City of Madison, Wisconsin](https://www.cityofmadison.com/dpced/housing): Housing Authority managing public housing applications and rent payments
- [City Assessor - City of Madison, Wisconsin](https://www.cityofmadison.com/assessor): Assessor's Office for property assessment and tax exemptions

## Workforce & Employee Services

- [Human Resources | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/human-resources): HR Department with job applications, benefits, and employment information
- [Employee Assistance Program | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/employee-assistance-program): Counseling and mental health support for city employees

## Recreation & Facilities

- [Golf | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/parks/golf): Public golf courses with tee time booking and memberships
- [Irwin A. and Robert D. Goodman Pool | Goodman Pool | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/parks/pool): Goodman Pool with seasonal hours and community swimming programs
- [Fleet | City of Madison, WI](https://www.cityofmadison.com/fleet): Fleet Management Department for city vehicle operations and sustainability
